title: tephroseris papposa subsp. kitaibelii
intro: Tephroseris papposa subsp. kitaibelii, commonly known as Kitaibel's or Montane Tephroseris, is a plant species in the daisy family that is native to the mountainous regions of Europe. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and alleviate respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and expectorant properties, which contribute to its use in treating a range of health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Tephroseris papposa subsp. kitaibelii include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
